Subject: A few new quiet rooms on the porch

Dear friend, We’ve gently added some new spaces to Today’s Daily Battle. They are simple, built for real hard days, and ready whenever your heart needs them. New Red-Letters paths • Only His Voice — five days with nothing but the words Jesus spoke https://todaysdailybattle.com/plans.html?plan=hisownwords • Come Unto Me — His own invitation when your words have run dry https://todaysdailybattle.com/plans.html?plan=comeuntome • When Fear Presses In — steady Scripture for anxious and fearful days https://todaysdailybattle.com/plans.html?plan=fearpressesin Life Lessons from the Word Sixteen deeper studies that walk through what the Bible teaches, how it meets us in real life, and how we can quietly prepare our hearts. Each one has a printable sheet and gentle ties back to the plans and tools. https://todaysdailybattle.com/life-lessons.html None of these ask anything extra from you. They are simply here — like a familiar chair you can sit in at any hour, with or without perfect words. You are always welcome. Come as you are. With quiet prayers, Brandon todaysdailybattle.com --- Reply with “unsubscribe” if you want to be removed from this list.
